evidence: Defines the mMAC1 phenotype as 5-day M-CSF MO-derived MAC under 1% O2 + 48h LPS, with proinflammatory cytokine secretion, reduced CD8 T-cell suppression, and a hypoxia-specific C2 demethylation cluster.

ChIP-seq of HIF1a + p65 across all four conditions resolves H1-H3 (HIF1a) and P1 (p65) clusters; cobound peaks have r=0.13 binding correlation and partition gene functions (HIF1a-only metabolic, p65-only differentiation/adhesion, cobound LPS-response).
Pharmacological dissection (BAY11-7082, PX-478, 4-octyl itaconate) plus ChIP-seq + EPIC + RNA-seq integration is the load-bearing experiment for the claim.
TCGA pan-cancer analysis (7/12 cancer types better OS) + BLCA mMAC1-T cell correlation (r=0.74) + IL4I1 sorted ovarian MAC validation.
HIF1a ChIP-seq + Western/IF + DoRothEA HIF1A regulon used to assign HIF1a-driven hypoxia adaptation arm; paper builds on canonical HIF1a oxygen-sensing biology.

4-octyl itaconate (TET inhibitor) used as positive control to confirm TET-dependence of C2 demethylation; extends the standard 'hypoxia inhibits TET globally' biology with locus-specific p65-licensed TET activity.
